ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This block diagram shows a DC servo motor position control system. The left input is Va(s), entering the first summing point, and Va(s) is the positive input; the motor speed is fed back through the Kb branch to the lower end of this summing point, as negative feedback. The output of the first summing point passes through the armature/torque channel KT/(Ra+La s). It then enters the second summing point; the torque generated by the motor on the left is the positive input, and the top disturbance torque Td(s) enters with a negative sign. The output of the second summing point passes through the mechanical link 1/(Js+B) to obtain angular velocity, and then passes through the integrator 1/s to obtain position θ(s). Reasoning: Only the response to the disturbance torque Td is sought, so let Va(s)=0. From negative feedback, the armature channel input is -Kb ω(s), so after the second summing point it satisfies ω(s) = [KT/(Ra+La s) · (-Kb ω(s)) - Td(s)]/(Js+B). Rearranging gives ω(s)/Td(s) = -(Ra+La s)/[(Js+B)(Ra+La s)+KT Kb]. The position θ(s)=ω(s)/s, therefore Θ(s)/Td(s) = -(Ra+La s)/{s[(Js+B)(Ra+La s)+KT Kb]}. Unit impulse disturbance Td(s)=1. The steady-state position response is given by the final value theorem: θss = lim_{s→0} s Θ(s) = -Ra/(B Ra + KT Kb). Substituting Ra=1, B=1, KT=1, Kb=1, gives θss = -1/(1·1+1·1) = -1/2 = -0.5 rad.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram as a cascade: error voltage goes through K_T/(R_a+L_a s), then is summed against the disturbance torque at the second summing junction, then goes through 1/(Js+B) to angular speed and 1/s to position; speed is fed back through K_b negatively to the first summing junction. Set Va(s)=0 because only disturbance response is requested. From the diagram, write omega = [K_T/(R_a+L_a s)(-K_b omega) - T_d]/(Js+B). Solve for omega/T_d = -(R_a+L_a s)/[(Js+B)(R_a+L_a s)+K_TK_b]. Then Theta/T_d = (1/s) omega/T_d. For a unit impulse, compute theta_ss = lim_{s->0} s Theta(s) = -R_a/(B R_a + K_TK_b). Substitute R_a=1, B=1, K_T=1, K_b=1 to get -1/(1+1) = -0.5 rad.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：该框图显示 DC 伺服电机位置控制系统。左侧输入为 Va(s)，进入第一个求和点，Va(s) 为正输入；由电机转速经 Kb 支路反馈到该求和点的下端，为负反馈。第一个求和点输出经过电枢/转矩通道 KT/(Ra+La s)。之后进入第二个求和点；左侧电机产生的转矩为正输入，顶部扰动转矩 Td(s) 以负号进入。第二个求和点输出经过机械环节 1/(Js+B) 得到角速度，再经过积分器 1/s 得到位置 θ(s)。

推理：只求扰动转矩 Td 的响应，因此令 Va(s)=0。由负反馈可得电枢通道输入为 -Kb ω(s)，所以第二个求和点后满足
ω(s) = [KT/(Ra+La s) · (-Kb ω(s)) - Td(s)]/(Js+B)。
整理得
ω(s)/Td(s) = -(Ra+La s)/[(Js+B)(Ra+La s)+KT Kb]。
位置 θ(s)=ω(s)/s，因此
Θ(s)/Td(s) = -(Ra+La s)/{s[(Js+B)(Ra+La s)+KT Kb]}。
单位冲激扰动 Td(s)=1。稳态位置响应由终值定理给出：
θss = lim_{s→0} s Θ(s) = -Ra/(B Ra + KT Kb)。
代入 Ra=1, B=1, KT=1, Kb=1，得到
θss = -1/(1·1+1·1) = -1/2 = -0.5 rad。

method.method_draft: First translate the visual blocks into differential equations with Va=0: L_a di/dt + R_a i = -K_b omega from the negative back-emf feedback, and J domega/dt + B omega = K_T i - T_d from the mechanical summing junction where disturbance enters negatively; also dtheta/dt=omega. For a unit impulse disturbance, integrate both equations from 0 to infinity. Since the system settles, the integral of di/dt and domega/dt terms is zero. Let Delta theta = int_0^infinity omega dt and I_area = int_0^infinity i dt. The integrated electrical equation gives R_a I_area = -K_b Delta theta. The integrated mechanical equation gives B Delta theta = K_T I_area - 1. Eliminate I_area to obtain (B + K_TK_b/R_a) Delta theta = -1, so Delta theta = -1/(B + K_TK_b/R_a). With all relevant constants equal to 1, Delta theta = -1/(1+1) = -0.5 rad.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是直流伺服电机的位置控制框图。左侧输入为 Va(s)，进入第一个求和点；从电机速度信号处经 Kb 反馈回该求和点，且反馈端为负号。求和点后接电枢/力矩通道 Kt/(Ra+La s)。随后进入第二个求和点；图中扰动转矩 Td(s) 从上方进入该求和点，并按负向作用到机械部分。第二个求和点后依次经过机械环节 1/(Js+B) 得到角速度，再经过积分环节 1/s 得到位置 θ(s)。

推理：求单位冲激扰动转矩 Td 对稳态位置的影响，令控制输入 Va=0。由图中负反馈反电势关系，电气方程为 La di/dt + Ra i = -Kb ω。由机械求和点中扰动转矩负向进入，机械方程为 J dω/dt + Bω = Kt i - Td，同时 dθ/dt=ω。

对单位冲激扰动 Td(t) 从 0 到 ∞ 积分。系统最终稳定，因此 ∫ di/dt dt 和 ∫ dω/dt dt 的首末差为 0。令 Δθ=∫0∞ ω dt，I_area=∫0∞ i dt。电气方程积分得 Ra I_area = -Kb Δθ。机械方程积分得 B Δθ = Kt I_area - 1，因为单位冲激扰动的面积为 1。消去 I_area：I_area=-(Kb/Ra)Δθ，代入机械方程得 BΔθ = -KtKb/Ra · Δθ - 1，即 (B + KtKb/Ra)Δθ = -1。所以 Δθ = -1/(B + KtKb/Ra)。代入 Kt=1、Kb=1、Ra=1、B=1，得到 Δθ = -1/(1+1) = -0.5 rad。

Image description: This block diagram shows a DC servo motor position control system. The left input is Va(s), entering the first summing point, and Va(s) is the positive input; the motor speed is fed back through the Kb branch to the lower end of this summing point, as negative feedback. The output of the first summing point passes through the armature/torque channel KT/(Ra+La s). It then enters the second summing point; the torque generated by the motor on the left is the positive input, and the top disturbance torque Td(s) enters with a negative sign. The output of the second summing point passes through the mechanical link 1/(Js+B) to obtain angular velocity, and then passes through the integrator 1/s to obtain position θ(s).

Reasoning: Only the response to the disturbance torque Td is sought, so let Va(s)=0. From negative feedback, the armature channel input is -Kb ω(s), so after the second summing point it satisfies
ω(s) = [KT/(Ra+La s) · (-Kb ω(s)) - Td(s)]/(Js+B).
Rearranging gives
ω(s)/Td(s) = -(Ra+La s)/[(Js+B)(Ra+La s)+KT Kb].
The position θ(s)=ω(s)/s, therefore
Θ(s)/Td(s) = -(Ra+La s)/{s[(Js+B)(Ra+La s)+KT Kb]}.
Unit impulse disturbance Td(s)=1. The steady-state position response is given by the final value theorem:
θss = lim_{s→0} s Θ(s) = -Ra/(B Ra + KT Kb).
Substituting Ra=1, B=1, KT=1, Kb=1, gives
θss = -1/(1·1+1·1) = -1/2 = -0.5 rad.

ready3_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The position control of a DC servo-motor is shown in <image>. The values of the parameters are \( K_T = 1 \, \text{N-m/A} \), \( R_a = 1 \, \Omega \), \( L_a = 0.1 \, \text{H} \), \( J = 5 \, \text{kg-m}^2 \), \( B = 1 \, \text{N-m/(rad/sec)} \), and \( K_b = 1 \, \text{V/(rad/sec)} \). The steady-state position response (in radians) due to unit impulse disturbance torque \( T_d \) is ________.
